answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation system anchored by a proof-of-stake mechanism to resist Sybil attacks. Each agent earns reputation pearls by contributing valuable computations, which are then staked to validate transactions. An attacker attempting to create fake identities would need to echo a large number of transactions through multiple lantern nodes, incurring significant computational and energy costs to maintain the requisite stake, thereby making the attack economically infeasible.
